definitions.gloss: toothpick — a small pointed stick of wood (or sometimes plastic) used to clean between the teeth or to pick up small pieces of food
definitions.explanation: An everyday item commonly found at Japanese restaurants and in households. The word is written in kanji as {爪楊枝|つまようじ} but is very often written in hiragana as つまようじ or even shortened to {楊枝|ようじ} in casual speech.

examples.japanese: {爪楊枝|つまようじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Could I have a toothpick, please?

examples.japanese: {爪楊枝|つまようじ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{歯|は}→歯：00778_ha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧にした。
examples.english: I cleaned between my teeth with a toothpick.

examples.japanese: ⟦レジ→レジ：00879_reji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{横|よこ}→横：02984_yoko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{爪楊枝|つまようじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{置|お}いてあります→置く：01092_oku⟧。
examples.english: There are toothpicks placed next to the register.

examples.japanese: ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{爪楊枝|つまようじ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{刺|さ}して→刺す：02111_sasu⟧、⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{火|ひ}→火：02248_hi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通|とお}っている→通る：01243_tooru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: I poked the food with a toothpick to check whether it was cooked all the way through.

notes:
An everyday household and restaurant item. Often written in hiragana (つまようじ) in casual contexts. In speech the kanji compound {楊枝|ようじ} is also common, especially in older or more traditional phrasing.

USAGE:
- In Japanese restaurants, a small container of toothpicks is usually provided near the register or on the table.
- There is a cultural expectation to cover the mouth with one hand when using a toothpick in public.
- Also commonly used as a skewer-like tool for tasting test (⟦{試食|ししょく}→試食：03060_shishoku⟧) samples or for checking doneness in cooking.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {爪楊枝|つまようじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use a toothpick
- {爪楊枝|つまようじ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{刺|さ}す→刺す：02111_sasu⟧: to poke with a toothpick
- {爪楊枝|つまようじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to take a toothpick
- {爪楊枝|つまようじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧: the tip of a toothpick

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {楊枝|ようじ}: shorter form of the same word; also covers broader dental-stick tools.
- ⟦{串|くし}→串：19339_kushi⟧: skewer — longer and used for grilling or serving food.
- デンタルフロス: dental floss — a modern alternative for cleaning between teeth.
